name: Myth Dug Up
footer:
Myth Dug Up — legends that turned out to be (partly) real. Every episode says what is proven and what is still debated.
#archaeology #history #shorts
style: Each myth is painted in the art style of its own culture (claude-drawing-skill: blackfigure, tomb, mosaic, codex, ukiyoe, ...); the dig is always an old field notebook (codex). Camera moves through one continuous world (bang-motion), paper cut-outs and stamps (vox-director).

titles: {n} Myths That Turned Out to Be Real (Archaeology Documentary)
Everyone Called These Myths. Then Someone Dug. ({n} Stories)
{n} Ancient Legends With Real Evidence Behind Them
long.intro: {n} legends that everyone called myths. And what happened when someone finally started digging.
long.outro: Which one surprised you most? Tell me in the comments, and subscribe for the next dig.
long.description:
{n} legends that turned out to be at least partly real — what is proven, and what is still debated.
Illustrations painted with code (no photos), narration is synthetic.
